product_overview: A Spring Boot backend for managing the Impact Health blog workflow from doctor draft creation through admin review to public publication. It supports public browsing of published posts, doctor-side blog authoring, admin moderation, category management, and local image uploads for testing.
core_goals: Support the full blog lifecycle: draft, submit, review, approve/reject/request changes, and publish
Allow doctors to create, edit, view, submit, and delete their own blog posts
Enable admins to review pending posts and manage blog categories
Expose public read-only APIs for browsing only published blogs with search, filtering, and pagination
Support local filesystem image uploads for blog featured and additional images
Enforce role-based access and validation with centralized error handling

features.name: Public Blog Browsing
features.description: Allows customers and other public consumers to browse only published blog content with filtering, search, and pagination.
user_flows: GET /api/public/blogs with search, category, page, and size parameters for published posts -> Receive 200 with a paginated Page<BlogDTO> containing only PUBLISHED blogs -> GET /api/public/blogs/{slug} for a published slug -> Receive 200 with BlogDTO including title, content, doctor, category, featured image, and additional images

GET /api/public/blogs?search=nutrition for public search -> Receive 200 with matching published posts by title or short description -> GET /api/public/blogs/{slug} for an unpublished slug -> Receive 404 Not Found or hidden result because non-PUBLISHED blogs must not be publicly accessible

GET /api/public/categories to list active categories -> Receive 200 with BlogCategoryDTO[] -> GET /api/public/blogs?page=0&size=10 to browse the first page -> Receive 200 with page metadata and results

features.name: Doctor Blog Management
features.description: Allows doctors to create and manage their own blog drafts, submit them for review, and update content after rejection or change requests.
user_flows: POST /api/blogs with title, content, summary, and categoryId -> Receive 201 Created with a BlogDTO in DRAFT status -> GET /api/blogs/my to view the doctor's blogs -> Receive 200 with the newly created draft in the results -> POST /api/blogs/{id}/submit to submit the draft -> Receive 200 with BlogDTO status changed to PENDING

PUT /api/blogs/{id} with updated title, content, summary, and categoryId for a DRAFT blog -> Receive 200 with updated BlogDTO -> POST /api/blogs/{id}/submit -> Receive 200 with BlogDTO status changed to PENDING -> GET /api/blogs/{id} to verify submitted details -> Receive 200 with BlogDTO

PUT /api/blogs/{id} for a PENDING or PUBLISHED blog -> Receive an error response such as 400/403 due to invalid edit state -> DELETE /api/blogs/{id} for a doctor-owned draft -> Receive 240 No Content / 204-style no-content success

GET /api/blogs/{id} for another doctor's private draft -> Receive 404 Not Found or forbidden result because doctors must not access another doctor's private drafts -> GET /api/blogs/my?status=DRAFT to list only own drafts -> Receive 200 with filtered results

features.name: Admin Blog Review and Moderation
features.description: Allows administrators to inspect pending content, approve or reject submissions, request changes, and delete blogs when needed.
user_flows: GET /api/admin/blogs/pending to list pending reviews -> Receive 200 with BlogDTO[] containing only PENDING blogs -> GET /api/admin/blogs/{id} for review details -> Receive 200 with full BlogDTO including images, doctor, category, status, and submission data -> POST /api/admin/blogs/{id}/approve -> Receive 200 with BlogDTO status changed to PUBLISHED and publishedAt populated

GET /api/admin/blogs/{id} for a submitted blog -> Receive 200 with blog details -> POST /api/admin/blogs/{id}/reject with reason text -> Receive 200 with BlogDTO status changed to REJECTED and rejection reason saved -> GET /api/public/blogs/{slug} -> Receive 404 or hidden result because rejected blogs must not appear publicly

GET /api/admin/blogs/{id} for a submitted blog -> Receive 200 with blog details -> POST /api/admin/blogs/{id}/request-changes with a message -> Receive 200 with BlogDTO status changed to CHANGES_REQUESTED and changeRequestMessage saved -> Doctor edits the blog with PUT /api/blogs/{id} and resubmits with POST /api/blogs/{id}/submit -> Receive 200 with status returning to PENDING
GET /api/admin/blogs?status=PENDING&category=1&page=0&size=10 to browse moderated content -> Receive 200 with Page<BlogDTO> -> DELETE /api/admin/blogs/{id} for admin removal -> Receive 204 No Content

features.name: Category Management
features.description: Allows the system to expose public categories and lets admins create and delete blog categories for organizing posts.
user_flows: GET /api/public/categories to browse active categories -> Receive 200 with BlogCategoryDTO[] -> GET /api/admin/categories or /api/admin/blog-categories to inspect admin category list if available in implementation -> Receive 200 with category data

POST /api/admin/categories with name, slug, and description -> Receive 201 Created with BlogCategoryDTO -> GET /api/public/categories -> Receive 200 and the new category appears among active categories -> DELETE /api/admin/categories/{id} -> Receive 204 No Content

POST /api/admin/categories with missing name or slug -> Receive 400 Validation Error with field messages -> POST /api/blogs with invalid categoryId -> Receive 400 Validation Error or invalid category error because submission requires a valid category

features.name: Blog Image Upload
features.description: Allows blog authors to upload featured and additional images using local filesystem storage for testing.
user_flows: POST /api/uploads with a valid multipart binary file -> Receive 200 with a JSON response containing url and message -> Attach the returned path to a blog image record or blog DTO for later display
POST /api/uploads with a disallowed or malformed file -> Receive 4xx error from file upload handling -> No image path is stored in MySQL because only successful uploads should persist references

POST /api/blogs/{id}/images with featured or additional image multipart data -> Receive 200/201 with stored local path information -> GET /api/public/blogs/{slug} for the published blog -> Receive 200 and the image references are included in the response

features.name: Validation and Error Handling
features.description: Ensures blog content, categories, and file uploads are validated with consistent error responses and centralized exception handling.
user_flows: POST /api/blogs with missing title, shortDescription, content, or categoryId -> Receive 400 Validation Error with clear field-level messages -> Correct the payload and resend POST /api/blogs -> Receive 201 Created

GET /api/public/blogs/{slug} for a nonexistent slug -> Receive 404 with a standardized error body -> GET /api/admin/blogs/{id}/approve for an invalid or nonexistent blog -> Receive 404 or an error response from centralized exception handling
POST /api/blogs/{id}/submit with incomplete required fields -> Receive 400 with validation feedback -> Fix the missing data and resubmit -> Receive 200 with status changed to PENDING
